content.name: Subtle Spell
entries: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to cast it without any somatic or verbal components.

content.name: Subtle Spell
entries: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to cast it without any Verbal, Somatic, or Material components, except Material components that are consumed by the spell or that have a cost specified in the spell.
